title.narrative: Enhanced enabling environment to promote the development and creation of green, sustainable and resilient enterprises in the entire value/supply chain, and particularly for MSMEs.

description.narrative:
PHL104 strengthens the enabling environment for sustainable and resilient enterprises, particularly micro, small and medium enterprises (MSMEs), to maximize productive, remunerative, freely chosen and sustainable work. It supports the MSME Development Plan for 2023-2028 and the Labour and Employment Plan (LEP) 2023–2028’s priority enterprise sustainability. The Country Programme Outcome (CPO) aligns with national strategies such as the National AI Strategy for the Philippines, the National AI Strategy Roadmap 2.0, the E-Government Masterplan, the E-Commerce Roadmap, the Philippine Export Development Plan and the National Digital Workforce Competitiveness Act. The CPO also supports two flagship legislative initiatives of the Philippine government: Tatak Pinoy (Proudly Filipino) Act and Trabaho Para sa Bayan Act. Furthermore, it also contributes to the UN Sustainable Development Cooperation Framework (UNSDCF) 2024–2028’s priority on sustainable economic development and decent work, by improving institutions and systems that foster a competitive, inclusive, and digitally integrated business environment.
The initiative benefits MSMEs and their workers by promoting enterprise formalization, just transition, responsible rural supply chains, women’s entrepreneurship, digital and AI-powered entrepreneurship and the adoption of digital wage systems. It also strengthens MSME resilience and enhances gender-responsive enterprise support, ensuring that decent work principles are embedded in business practices.
The strategy is implemented with government institutions, workers’ and employers’ organizations, and other key national partners to improve policy coherence and the delivery of enterprise support services. By advancing digital and AI-driven transformation, entrepreneurship, and market access, PHL104 contributes to stronger and more competitive MSMEs capable of generating quality employment and supporting inclusive economic growth.
